idea-plugin.name: C++ Modules Language Server
idea-plugin.description:
mcppls - C++20 named modules that work on any compiler. mcpp-language-server normalizes how the project is built — mcpp, CMake, a compile_commands.json, or nothing — into one module description, drives its own pinned clangd with it, and answers module-level requests.

The plugin carries the server, its pinned clangd for every system and the openkal semantic kit: nothing else to install. Where no compiler is found, a project is read with the semantic kit of its target; the kit of this system is installed in the background once you agree, and meanwhile the openkal kit reads the files. A file is answered by one engine: projects CLion models (CMake, a compilation database, Makefile) stay CLion's, every other project is mcppls's, and in those files the plugin asks once whether CLion's own engine should stop answering them (Settings | Tools | mcppls).

action.text: Use mcppls Only in This Project
action.description: CLion's own C/C++ engine stops answering the files mcppls answers in this project

action.text: Restore CLion's Engine in This Project
action.description: CLion's own C/C++ engine answers the files mcppls answers again, as before
A semantic kit this project lacks is asked about again before it is installed
Stops mcppls for this project and starts it again
Removes this project's mcppls cache and reads the project again
